blocks.prompt: 6. A vehicle moving with a speed of 36 km/h is stopped by applying brakes and comes to rest in 10 seconds. Find the retardation and distance covered during this time.
blocks.explanation:
Brakes lagne se raftaar ek jaisi rate se kam hoti hai, yani acceleration constant (negative) hai, is liye motion ki equations lagengi.
Diya kya hai? u = 36 km/h, v = 0 (ruk jati hai), t = 10 s.
Find kya karna hai? Retardation (raftaar kam hone ki rate) aur faasla.
Plan: pehle km/h ko m/s mein badlein, phir \(v = u + at\) se a, aur \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) se x.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(u = 36\) km/h, \(v = 0\) (gari ruk jati hai), \(t = 10\) s.
Maloom karna: retardation aur faasla \(x\).
Tareeqa: constant acceleration ki equations of motion (7.1.6): \(v = u + at\) aur \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\). Time seconds mein hai, is liye pehle speed ko bhi m/s mein lana zaroori hai, warna units mix ho jayenge.

Speed ko m/s mein badlein
\[u = 36 \times \dfrac{1000}{3600}\]
\[= 36 \times \dfrac{5}{18} = 10\text{ m/s}\]
Kyun: 1 km = 1000 m aur 1 h = 3600 s, is liye 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s. Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: km/h ko m/s banana ho to 5/18 se multiply.
Dhyan dein: 36 ko seedha formula mein rakhna sab se aam ghalti hai; phir jawab bilkul ghalat aata hai.

\(v = u + at\) se acceleration
\[0 = 10 + a(10)\]
\[a = -1\text{ m/s}^2\]
Kyun: yeh equation u, v, a aur t ko jorti hai aur is mein sirf a maloom nahi. Minus sign batata hai ke velocity kam ho rahi hai; isi ko retardation kehte hain, aur us ki miqdaar 1 m/s\(^2\) hai.

\(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) se faasla
\[x = 10(10) + \tfrac{1}{2}(-1)(10)^2\]
\[= 100 - 50 = 50\text{ m}\]
Kyun: ab u, a aur t teeno maloom hain. Gari sirf ek hi direction mein chalti hai, is liye yahan displacement hi distance hai.
Dhyan dein: a ka minus sign zaroor saath rakhein; agar +1 rakh diya to 150 m aayega jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq: \(2ax = v^2 - u^2\) se
\[2(-1)(50) = -100\]
\[0^2 - 10^2 = -100 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: teesri equation of motion bhi wohi baat kehti hai. Graph se bhi dekh lein: velocity-time graph ke neeche triangle ka area \(\frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 10 = 50\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: Retardation \(= 1\) m/s\(^2\) (yani \(a = -1\) m/s\(^2\)); tay kiya gaya faasla \(= 50\) m
